summary: Completed frontend testing of P0 waypoint features: waypoint creation, drag-and-drop, GPX export, and live GPS flow mode. All 5 requested features are working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Waypoints correctly implement draggable={true} with proper event handlers (dragstart, drag, dragend)
GPX export uses gpxUtils.js for client-side generation - compatible with Garmin, Avenza, GPS devices
Live GPS flow mode (FLUX EN DIRECT) shows real-time coordinates during waypoint placement and dragging
Auto-analysis triggers after waypoint confirmation when autoAnalyzeOnConfirm is enabled
Waypoint markers use custom icon with flag emoji (🚩) and orange background (#f59e0b)
seed_data_creation: Created waypoint 'Test Waypoint Drag' during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0 waypoint features verified working. Waypoints section shows count and list. GPX quick export button (data-testid='export-gpx-quick-btn') exports waypoints. Import/Export GPX section has separate Export and Import buttons. Live GPS flow mode activates when waypoint tool is active or during waypoint drag.
